newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas up next winter but only two deals done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas up next winter but only two deals done.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures saw only 50 lots traded in two deals on Thursday afternoon, with prices rising in each case.
January traded 25 lots at 17.00 pence a therm, up by 0.05 pence from the previous settlement price. And the same volume traded in April at 11.40 pence, a rise of 0.235 pence a therm.
But bids dropped in the front months. By the close both August and September were bid below 9.00 pence a therm even though neither was traded.

Prices on both the spot and futures markets have been volatile in recent days, with Thursday's rise next winter following a slight fall on Wednesday. But volumes were thinner on Thursday, after 180 lots had been traded the previous day.
